def fn(view, s):
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    hh = pd.Index(view.households)
    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)

    def win_spend(lo, hi):
        m = (tx.day >= lo) & (tx.day <= hi)
        return tx[m].groupby("household_key").sales_value.sum().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)

    feats["spend_lag364"] = win_spend(s-363, s-336)
    feats["spend_lag364_2"] = win_spend(s-391, s-364)  # two years? data ~2 years, early snapshots won't have. Maybe skip.
    feats["spend_7"] = win_spend(s-6, s)
    feats["spend_14"] = win_spend(s-13, s)
    # recency
    last_day = tx.groupby("household_key").day.max().reindex(hh)
    feats["days_since_last"] = s - last_day
    first_day = tx.groupby("household_key").day.min().reindex(hh)
    feats["tenure"] = s - first_day
    # baskets in windows
    b = tx.drop_duplicates(["household_key","basket_id"])
    for w in (28, 56, 84):
        m = (b.day > s - w)
        feats[f"baskets_{w}"] = b[m].groupby("household_key").size().reindex(hh, fill_value=0)
    # mean inter-purchase gap over last 84 days
    ...
    # momentum
    feats["spend_28_prev"] = win_spend(s-55, s-28)
    feats["trend_28"] = feats["spend_28"] / (feats["spend_28_prev"] + 1)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np

E1 = "e001_recent_behavior.parquet"

def fn(view, s):
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name="household_key")
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    base = agent_api.load_saved(E1)
    base = base[base.snapshot_day == s].set_index("household_key").drop(columns=["snapshot_day"])
    feats = base.reindex(hh)

    t = tx[tx.household_key.isin(hh)] if len(tx) else tx
    g = t.groupby("household_key")

    def wsum(lo, hi, col="sales_value"):
        m = (t.day >= lo) & (t.day <= hi)
        return t.loc[m].groupby("household_key")[col].sum().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)

    # recency & tenure
    last = g.day.max().reindex(hh)
    first = g.day.min().reindex(hh)
    feats["days_since_last"] = (s - last).astype(float)
    feats["tenure_days"] = (s - first).astype(float)

    # short-window spend
    feats["spend_7"] = wsum(s-6, s)
    feats["spend_14"] = wsum(s-13, s)

    # prior windows & trend
    prev28 = wsum(s-55, s-28)
    feats["trend_28"] = feats["spend_28"] / (prev28 + 1.0) if "spend_28" in feats else wsum(s-27,s)/(prev28+1)
    feats["dormant_28"] = (feats["spend_28"] <= 0).astype(float) if "spend_28" in feats else (wsum(s-27,s)<=0).astype(float)

    # year-ago same window (s-363 .. s-336)
    feats["spend_lag364"] = wsum(s-363, s-336)
    feats["spend_lag364_flag"] = (feats["spend_lag364"] > 0).astype(float)

    # decayed spend (EWMA over 84d, half-life 28d)
    t84 = t[(t.day > s-84)]
    age = (s - t84.day).clip(lower=0)
    dec = np.power(0.5, age/28.0)
    feats["spend_ewma84"] = t84.assign(_d=dec*t84.sales_value).groupby("household_key")["_d"].sum().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)

    # cadence
    b = t.drop_duplicates(["household_key","basket_id"])
    b84 = b[b.day > s-84]
    feats["baskets_84"] = b84.groupby("household_key").size().reindex(hh, fill_value=0).astype(float)
    feats["active_days_28"] = t[t.day > s-28].groupby("household_key").day.nunique().reindex(hh, fill_value=0).astype(float)
    # mean inter-basket gap in last 84d
    def gap(sub):
        d = np.sort(sub.day.unique())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np

E1 = "e001_recent_behavior.parquet"

def fn(view, s):
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name="household_key")
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    base = agent_api.load_saved(E1)
    base = base[base.snapshot_day == s].set_index("household_key").drop(columns=["snapshot_day"])
    feats = base.reindex(hh)

    t = tx[tx.household_key.isin(hh)] if len(tx) else tx
    g = t.groupby("household_key")

    def wsum(lo, hi, col="sales_value"):
        m = (t.day >= lo) & (t.day <= hi)
        return t.loc[m].groupby("household_key")[col].sum().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)

    # recency & tenure
    last = g.day.max().reindex(hh)
    first = g.day.min().reindex(hh)
    feats["days_since_last"] = (s - last).astype(float)
    feats["tenure_days"] = (s - first).astype(float)

    # short-window spend
    feats["spend_7"] = wsum(s-6, s)
    feats["spend_14"] = wsum(s-13, s)

    # prior windows & trend
    prev28 = wsum(s-55, s-28)
    feats["trend_28"] = feats["spend_28"] / (prev28 + 1.0) if "spend_28" in feats else wsum(s-27,s)/(prev28+1)
    feats["dormant_28"] = (feats["spend_28"] <= 0).astype(float) if "spend_28" in feats else (wsum(s-27,s)<=0).astype(float)

    # year-ago same window (s-363 .. s-336)
    feats["spend_lag364"] = wsum(s-363, s-336)
    feats["spend_lag364_flag"] = (feats["spend_lag364"] > 0).astype(float)

    # decayed spend (EWMA over 84d, half-life 28d)
    t84 = t[(t.day > s-84)]
    age = (s - t84.day).clip(lower=0)
    dec = np.power(0.5, age/28.0)
    feats["spend_ewma84"] = t84.assign(_d=dec*t84.sales_value).groupby("household_key")["_d"].sum().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)

    # cadence
    b = t.drop_duplicates(["household_key","basket_id"])
    b84 = b[b.day > s-84]
    feats["baskets_84"] = b84.groupby("household_key").size().reindex(hh, fill_value=0).astype(float)
    feats["active_days_28"] = t[t.day > s-28].groupby("household_key").day.nunique().reindex(hh, fill_value=0).astype(float)
    # mean inter-basket gap in last 84d
    def gap(sub):
        d = np.sort(sub.day.unique())
        if len(d) < 2: return np.nan
        return np.mean(np.diff(d))
    feats["gap_mean_84"] = b84.groupby("household_key").day.apply(gap)
    feats["gap_mean_84"] = feats["gap_mean_84"].reindex(hh)

    # expected spend: trailing 4-week rate * recency survival
    feats["rate_84_per4w"] = feats["spend_84"]/3.0 if "spend_84" in feats else wsum(s-83,s)/3.0
    feats["exp_spend_recency"] = feats["rate_84_per4w"] * np.exp(-feats["days_since_last"].fillna(84)/28.0)

    # log transforms
    for c in ["spend_28","spend_84","spend_365"]:
        if c in feats:
            feats["log1p_"+c] = np.log1p(feats[c].clip(lower=0))

    return feats

import numpy as np, pandas as pd

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    d = int(view.day)
    hh = view.households
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    tx = tx[(tx.day <= d) & (tx.day > d - 400)]
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    if len(tx) == 0:
        return out
    sv = tx['sales_value']

    def wsum(w, col='sales_value'):
        m = tx['day'] > d - w
        return tx.loc[m].groupby('household_key')[col].sum()

    out['x_spend_7d'] = wsum(7)
    out['x_spend_14d'] = wsum(14)
    # recency / tenure
    last = tx.groupby('household_key')['day'].max()
    first = tx.groupby('household_key')['day'].min()
    out['x_days_since_last'] = d - last
    out['x_tenure'] = d - first
    # active days
    a28 = tx[tx.day > d-28].groupby('household_key')['day'].nunique()
    a84 = tx[tx.day > d-84].groupby('household_key')['day'].nunique()
    out['x_active_days_28'] = a28
    out['x_active_days_84'] = a84
    # baskets
    b28 = tx[tx.day > d-28].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique()
    out['x_baskets_28'] = b28
    s28 = wsum(28)
    out['x_avg_basket_28'] = s28 / b28
    out['x_units_28'] = wsum(28, 'quantity')
    # gaps in trailing 84
    def gap_mean(g):
        ds = g.dropna().unique()
        if len(ds) < 2: return np.nan
        ds = np.sort(ds)
        return float(np.mean(np.diff(ds)))
    gaps = tx[tx.day > d-84].groupby('household_key')['day'].apply(gap_mean)
    out['x_gap_mean_84'] = gaps
    # weekly slope trailing 84
    t84 = tx[tx.day > d-84].copy()
    t84['wk'] = (d - t84['day']) // 7
    ws = t84.groupby(['household_key','wk'])['sales_value'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0.0)
    ws = ws.reindex(columns=range(12), fill_value=0.0)
    x = np.arange(12, dtype=float)
    xm = x - x.mean()
    denom = (xm**2).sum()
    slope = (ws.values * xm).sum(axis=1) / denom
    out['x_slope_84'] = pd.Series(slope, index=ws.index)
    # momentum ratio
    s84 = wsum(84)
    prior_rate = (s84 - s28) / 56.0
    out['x_momentum'] = (s28/28.0) / (prior_rate + 0.5)
    # ewma half-life 28 over 365d
    t365 = tx[tx.day > d-365]
    wgt = 0.5 ** ((d - t365['day']) / 28.0)
    out['x_ewma_28hl'] = t365.groupby('household_key').apply(lambda g: np.sum(g['sales_value'].values * (0.5 ** ((d - g['day'].values)/28.0))))

e5 = agent_api.load_saved('e005_decay_gapcv.parquet')

def fn(view, d):
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    hh = pd.Index(view.households)
    tx = tx[tx['household_key'].isin(hh)]
    days = tx['day']
    def wsum(lo, hi):
        msk = (days >= lo) & (days <= hi)
        return tx.loc[msk].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    def wtrips(lo, hi):
        msk = (days >= lo) & (days <= hi)
        return tx.loc[msk].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique()
    s28 = wsum(d-27, d).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    sp28 = wsum(d-55, d-28).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    s365 = wsum(d-364, d).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    out['spend_prev28'] = sp28
    out['mom28_delta'] = s28 - sp28
    out['mom28_ratio'] = (s28 + 1.0) / (sp28 + 1.0)
    out['accel'] = s28/28.0 - s365/365.0
    rate13 = s365/13.0
    out['recent_vs_typ'] = (s28 + 1.0)/(rate13 + 1.0)
    # weekly sums
    def weekly(ndays):
        r = tx[days > d - ndays]
        wk = (d - r['day'])//7
        p = r.assign(_w=wk).groupby(['household_key','_w'])['sales_value'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0.0)
        p = p.reindex(columns=range(ndays//7), fill_value=0.0).reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
        return p
    p12 = weekly(84)
    x = np.arange(12.0); xc = x - x.mean()
    out['slope_12w'] = p12.values @ xc / (xc @ xc)
    p26 = weekly(182)
    a = p26.values
    out['wcv_26'] = a.std(axis=1)/(a.mean(axis=1) + 1.0)
    # seasonal windows aligned to future window
    out['lag364_4w'] = wsum(d-363, d-336).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out['lag336_4w'] = wsum(d-335, d-308).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out['lag364_ratio'] = (out['lag364_4w'] + 1.0)/(rate13 + 1.0)
    # trips
    tr28 = wtrips(d-27, d).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    trp = wtrips(d-55, d-28).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out['trips_ratio'] = (tr28 + 0.5)/(trp + 0.5)
    b28 = s28/tr28.replace(0, np.nan)
    bp = sp28/trp.replace(0, np.nan)
    out['basket_ratio'] = (b28.fillna(0.0) + 1.0)/(bp.fillna(0.0) + 1.0)
    last = tx.groupby('household_key')['day'].max().reindex(hh)
    out['days_since_trip'] = (d - last).fillna(999.0)
    m28 = tx[days > d-28]
    out['active_days_28'] = m28.groupby('household_key')['day'].nunique().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    age = (d - days).astype(float)
    ew28 = (tx['sales_value']*np.power(0.5, age/28.0)).groupby(tx['household_key']).sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    ew180 = (tx['sales_value']*np.power(0.5, age/180.0)).groupby(tx['household_key']).sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out['ew_mom'] = (ew28 + 1.0)/(ew180 + 1.0)
    return out

df = agent_api.build_features(fn)
if 'household_key' not in df.columns:
    df = df.reset_index()
newcols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in e5.columns and c not in ('household_key','snapshot_day')]

print('new corr with target:')
print(mt[newcols + ['future_spend_4w']].corr()['future_spend_4w'].drop('future_spend_4w').sort_values().round(3).to_string())
```

```python
import agent_api, pandas as pd, numpy as np

e5 = agent_api.load_saved('e005_decay_gapcv.parquet')
print('E005 cols:', list(e5.columns))
print('E005 shape:', e5.shape)
t = agent_api.train_targets()
m = e5.merge(t, on=['household_key','snapshot_day'])
y = m['future_spend_4w']
print('target:', y.describe().round(2).to_dict())
print('zero share: %.3f' % (y == 0).mean())
print('E005 corr with target:')
print(m.corr(numeric_only=True)['future_spend_4w'].drop('future_spend_4w').sort_values().round(3).to_string())

def fn(view, d):
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    hh = pd.Index(view.households)
    tx = tx[tx['household_key'].isin(hh)]
    days = tx['day']
    def wsum(lo, hi):
        msk = (days >= lo) & (days <= hi)
        return tx.loc[msk].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    def wtrips(lo, hi):
        msk = (days >= lo) & (days <= hi)
        return tx.loc[msk].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique()
    s28 = wsum(d-27, d).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    sp28 = wsum(d-55, d-28).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    s365 = wsum(d-364, d).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    out['spend_prev28'] = sp28
    out['mom28_delta'] = s28 - sp28
    out['mom28_ratio'] = (s28 + 1.0) / (sp28 + 1.0)
    out['accel'] = s28/28.0 - s365/365.0
    rate13 = s365/13.0
    out['recent_vs_typ'] = (s28 + 1.0)/(rate13 + 1.0)
    # weekly sums
    def weekly(ndays):
        r = tx[days > d - ndays]
        wk = (d - r['day'])//7
        p = r.assign(_w=wk).groupby(['household_key','_w'])['sales_value'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0.0)
        p = p.reindex(columns=range(ndays//7), fill_value=0.0).reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
        return p
    p12 = weekly(84)
    x = np.arange(12.0); xc = x - x.mean()
    out['slope_12w'] = p12.values @ xc / (xc @ xc)
    p26 = weekly(182)
    a = p26.values
    out['wcv_26'] = a.std(axis=1)/(a.mean(axis=1) + 1.0)
    # seasonal windows aligned to future window
    out['lag364_4w'] = wsum(d-363, d-336).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out['lag336_4w'] = wsum(d-335, d-308).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out['lag364_ratio'] = (out['lag364_4w'] + 1.0)/(rate13 + 1.0)
    # trips
    tr28 = wtrips(d-27, d).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    trp = wtrips(d-55, d-28).reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out['trips_ratio'] = (tr28 + 0.5)/(trp + 0.5)
    b28 = s28/tr28.replace(0, np.nan)
    bp = sp28/trp.replace(0, np.nan)
    out['basket_ratio'] = (b28.fillna(0.0) + 1.0)/(bp.fillna(0.0) + 1.0)
    last = tx.groupby('household_key')['day'].max().reindex(hh)
    out['days_since_trip'] = (d - last).fillna(999.0)
    m28 = tx[days > d-28]

def make_e007(view, snapshot_day):
    day = view.day
    hh = view.households
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    idx = pd.Index(hh, name='household_key') if not isinstance(hh, pd.Index) else hh
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=idx)
    if len(tx)==0:
        return out.assign(...) zeros
    t = tx
    g = t.groupby('household_key')
    out['days_since_last'] = day - g['day'].max()
    out['tenure_days'] = day - g['day'].min()
    # trailing 84
    t84 = t[t['day'] > day-84]
    g84 = t84.groupby('household_key')
    out['active_days_84'] = g84['day'].nunique().reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    out['trips_84'] = g84['basket_id'].nunique().reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    out['n_stores_84'] = g84['store_id'].nunique().reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    out['n_products_84'] = g84['product_id'].nunique().reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    spend84 = g84['sales_value'].sum().reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    out['spend_per_trip_84'] = spend84 / out['trips_84'].replace(0, np.nan)
    out['items_per_trip_84'] = g84['quantity'].sum().reindex(idx).fillna(0) / out['trips_84'].replace(0,np.nan)
    # top store share
    st = t84.groupby(['household_key','store_id'])['sales_value'].sum()
    top = st.groupby('household_key').max().reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    out['top_store_share_84'] = top / spend84.replace(0, np.nan)
    # aligned 28d windows over trailing 364
    off = day - t['day']
    k = ((off + 27) // 28) - 1
    k = k.clip(lower=0)  # same-day purchase into window 0
    tk = t.assign(k=k)
    wk = tk[tk['k'] <= 12]
    wspend = wk.groupby(['household_key','k'])['sales_value'].sum()
    # windows observed per household: from first purchase window to 0
    first_w = ((day - g['day'].min() ) )  # tenure
    # observed windows: k such that window end day-28k >= first_purchase_day → 28k <= day - first_day → k <= (day-first_day)/28
    tenure = (day - g['day'].min()).reindex(idx)

    kmax = np.floor((tenure/28) - 1).clip(lower=0).astype(int)
    kmax_eff = np.minimum(kmax, 12)
    n_obs = (kmax_eff + 1).astype(float)
    wsp = wspend.unstack('k').reindex(idx).fillna(0)  # columns k
    zero_cnt = (wsp == 0).sum(axis=1)
    # limit to observed windows: for households with tenure<364, only k<=kmax_eff observed; columns beyond kmax_eff should be excluded from both numerator and denominator.
    # Build mask matrix: for each household, valid ks are 0..kmax_eff.
    K = np.arange(wsp.shape[1])[None, :]
    valid = K <= kmax_eff.values[:, None]
    zero_cnt = ((wsp.values == 0) & valid).sum(axis=1)
    n_obs = valid.sum(axis=1)
    out['zero_win_frac_364'] = zero_cnt / np.maximum(n_obs, 1)
    out['n_obs_windows'] = n_obs
    act = (wsp > 0)

    mean_active = np.where(act.values & valid, wsp.values, np.nan)
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter('ignore')
        mact = np.nanmean(np.where(act.values & valid, wsp.values, np.nan), axis=1)
    mact = pd.Series(mact, index=idx).fillna(0)
    out['spend_per_active_win'] = mact
    out['expected_364'] = out['active_win_frac_364'] * mact

    out['n_products_84'] = g84['product_id'].nunique().reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    spend84 = g84['sales_value'].sum().reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    out['spend_per_trip_84'] = spend84 / out['trips_84'].replace(0, np.nan)
    out['items_per_trip_84'] = g84['quantity'].sum().reindex(idx).fillna(0) / out['trips_84'].replace(0,np.nan)

    top = st.groupby('household_key').max().reindex(idx).fillna(0)

Let me continue. I have 13 tool calls left before my next experiment. I was planning to probe the target distribution vs predictions. But I don't have model predictions — I can't run the model myself. I could fit my own simple model (e.g., gradient boosting or ridge) locally in run_python to understand errors, since allowed imports include numpy/pandas only... no sklearn. Hmm, allowed imports: agent_api, collections, dataclasses, datetime, functools, itertools, math, numpy, operator, pandas, re, statistics, time, typing, warnings. No sklearn. So I can't easily fit a GBM. I could fit a ridge regression with numpy, or a simple regression tree manually.

Alternative: analyze the target structure to design better features. Key insight: future_spend_4w is the sum over days snapshot+1..+28. Grocery spend is bursty: households shop in cycles. A strong predictor: spend in the window 4 weeks ago (lag 28-56) — i.e., "spend_lag336" exists (336 days = 12 cycles of 28). Do we have spend in the immediately preceding 4-week cycle (days snapshot-27..snapshot)? spend_28 is trailing 28 days (snapshot-27..snapshot). The next 4 weeks align with the next cycle of a ~28-day shopping cycle. spend_28 covers the current cycle. But if a household shops every 28 days, the future window might contain one trip whose timing relative to snapshot matters. days_since_last tells recency: if they just shopped, next trip is ~28 days out — could fall inside or outside the window.

Better features:
1. spend in days [snapshot-55, snapshot-28] (the previous cycle, spend_28_prior exists = spend in prior 28-day window).
2. Expected next-trip timing: days_since_last + typical gap → does the next trip land in window? e.g., predicted days until next purchase = max(gap, days_since_last + gap)? Actually if last trip was d days ago and typical gap is g, next trip expected at g - d days from now if d < g, else soon. Feature: expected next trip in window (binary/continuous), expected number of trips in window = f(days_since_last, gap distribution).
3. Trip-level simulation: expected future spend = (spend per trip) * expected trips in next 28 days. Expected trips: for a household with inter-trip gap distribution, the probability that a trip occurs in (t, t+28] given last trip d days ago. Could approximate via renewal process: expected count = sum over k of P(trip k in window). Simple approximation: 28/gap adjusted for phase: expected trips ≈ ((28 - (g - d mod g))/g) rounded... Let me define phase = (days_since_last mod gap_cycle). Hmm.

Simpler: households have periodicity. Compute per household the autocorrelation of daily spend at lag 28 vs neighbors, or the "cycle alignment": correlation between spend in trailing 28d windows offset by multiples of 28.

Actually a cleaner predictive feature: spend_28_prior (already in), and "spend in the 28-day window that is phase-aligned with the future window" — i.e., the window [snapshot-27-k*28... ] all are phase aligned since snapshot days are multiples of 28 offset. Snapshot days are every 28 days (95, 123, ...). So windows [s-27, s], [s-55, s-28], etc. are all aligned with the future window [s+1, s+28]. spend_28 and spend_28_prior already capture the two most recent aligned cycles. What about average of aligned cycles over the past year: mean of 13 aligned 28d windows = spend_365/13 ≈ longrun. Already have spend_365.

What's missing: trip timing phase. The future window starts at s+1. A household's trips have a phase relative to the 28-day grid. If their last trip was at day s (just before snapshot), the next trip is likely around s+28 — inside the window. If last trip was at s-20, next at ~s+8 — inside. If gap is 40 days and last trip at s-30, next at s+10 — inside. Hmm, actually for any gap g and last trip d days ago, next trip at g-d days ahead (if positive). It's inside the 28-day window iff g-d <= 28, i.e., d >= g-28. Expected spend in window ≈ basket_avg * E[# trips in (s, s+28]].

E[# trips] can be estimated from the household's gap distribution: with gaps G_i, the next trip time = d + G_next where G_next ~ empirical gap dist. # trips in window = count of cumulative sums of gaps ≤ 28 - ... Let me just compute: simulate using empirical gap distribution: for each of the household's last K gaps, compute where trips would land if the next gap equals each observed gap; average the resulting trip counts and spend. That's a nice "renewal-forecast" feature:

For k in household's inter-trip gaps (say last 8): simulate sequence starting from last trip day L: t1 = L + g_k, t2 = t1 + g_{k+1} (cycling), ... count trips with day in (s, s+28], sum their "expected basket" (avg basket or basket of corresponding position). Average over k. This gives a model-based forecast feature. That could be a meaningful improvement over flat windows, especially for the zero-spend cases and bursty households.

Also: weekday/phase alignment within the window doesn't matter since only total spend matters.

Another idea: the target is heavily right-skewed with 20% zeros. MAE-optimal prediction is the conditional median. The fixed model is a regression (probably GBM or ridge — unknown). We can't change it. But we can transform features to help. If the model is linear (ridge), log-transformed features would help a lot. If it's a GBM, less so. E001 with raw spend features got 63.6. Hard to know. Let me test: build a variant of E005 with log1p transforms of all spend/count features. If model is linear, this should improve substantially. That's a cheap, informative experiment (E007).

def feats(view, snapshot_day):
    end = snapshot_day
    t = view.table('transactions'); t = t[t.day<=end]
    hh_all = view.households  # index
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh_all)

    # daily spend
    daily = t.groupby(['household_key','day'])['sales_value'].sum()

    # window sums helper
    def wsum(lo):  # (end-lo, end]
        return t[(t.day>end-lo)&(t.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()

    for name, lo in [('spend_7',7),('spend_14',14),('spend_28',28),('spend_56',56),('spend_84',84),('spend_180',180),('spend_365',365)]:
        out[name] = wsum(lo)
    out['spend_28_prior'] = t[(t.day>end-56)&(t.day<=end-28)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    out['spend_84_prior'] = t[(t.day>end-168)&(t.day<=end-84)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()

    # ew decays on daily spend
    d = daily.reset_index(); d['age'] = end - d['day']
    for hl in [7,14,28,56,84,180]:
        wgt = 0.5**(d['age']/hl)
        out['ew_%d'%hl] = (d['sales_value']*wgt).groupby(d['household_key']).sum()

    # lags: spend in (end-lag-28, end-lag]
    for lag in [336,364,392]:
        out['spend_lag%d'%lag] = t[(t.day>end-lag-28)&(t.day<=end-lag)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()

    total = t.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    first_day = t.groupby('household_key')['day'].min()
    tenure_wk = ((end - first_day)/7.0).replace(0, np.nan)
    out['longrun_wk'] = total/tenure_wk
    out['ratio28_lr'] = out['spend_28']/(out['longrun_wk']*4).replace(0,np.nan)
    out['ratio84_lr'] = out['spend_84']/(out['longrun_wk']*12).replace(0,np.nan)

    # baskets
    b84 = t[(t.day>end-84)&(t.day<=end)]
    bsum = b84.groupby(['household_key','basket_id'])['sales_value'].sum()
    bcnt = bsum.groupby('household_key').agg(baskets_84='size', basket_max_84='max', basket_std_84='std', basket_med_84='median')
    out = out.join(bcnt)
    out['baskets_28'] = t[(t.day>end-28)&(t.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique()
    out['baskets_14'] = t[(t.day>end-14)&(t.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique()
    out['baskets_7'] = t[(t.day>end-7)&(t.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique()

    last = t.groupby('household_key')['day'].max()
    out['days_since_last'] = end - last
    out['days_since_first'] = end - first_day
    out['avg_basket_84'] = out['spend_84']/out['baskets_84'].replace(0,np.nan)
    out['trips_per_wk_84'] = out['baskets_84']/12.0
    out['spend_28_ratio'] = out['spend_28']/out['spend_28_prior'].replace(0,np.nan)
    out['n_products_84'] = b84.groupby('household_key')['product_id'].nunique()
    out['n_stores_84'] = b84.groupby('household_key')['store_id'].nunique()
    out['spend_trend'] = (out['spend_28']-out['spend_28_prior'])/28.0
    out['active_28'] = (out['baskets_28']>0).astype(float)

    # active days
    out['active_days_28'] = t[(t.day>end-28)&(t.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['day'].nunique()
    out['active_days_14'] = t[(t.day>end-14)&(t.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['day'].nunique()

    # gaps over trailing 180d trip days
    td = t[(t.day>end-180)&(t.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['day'].unique()
    gaps = td.apply(lambda a: np.diff(np.sort(a)) if len(a)>1 else np.array([]))
    out['gap_mean_180'] = gaps.apply(lambda a: a.mean() if len(a)>0 else np.nan)
    out['gap_cv'] = gaps.apply(lambda a: (a.std()/a.mean()) if len(a)>1 and a.mean()>0 else np.nan)
    out['max_gap_180'] = gaps.apply(lambda a: a.max() if len(a)>0 else np.nan)
    out['recency_ratio'] = out['days_since_last']/out['gap_mean_180']

    # zero weeks in trailing 26w
    blk = ((end - t['day'])//7)
    tb = t.assign(blk=blk)
    wk_spend = tb[tb.blk<26].groupby(['household_key','blk'])['sales_value'].sum()
    active_blocks = wk_spend.groupby('household_key').size()
    out['zero_weeks_26'] = 1 - active_blocks/26.0

    # basket trajectory
    b28 = t[(t.day>end-28)&(t.day<=end)].groupby(['household_key','basket_id'])['sales_value'].sum()
    ab28 = b28.groupby('household_key').mean()
    out['avg_basket_28'] = ab28
    out['basket_28_vs_84'] = out['avg_basket_28']/out['avg_basket_84']

    # lines per basket, quantity per basket (84d)
    lines = b84.groupby('household_key').size()
    out['lines_per_basket_84'] = lines/out['baskets_84'].replace(0,np.nan)
    qty = b84.groupby('household_key')['quantity'].sum()
    out['units_per_basket_84'] = qty/out['baskets_84'].replace(0,np.nan)
    out['unit_price_84'] = out['spend_84']/qty.replace(0,np.nan)

    # discount share
    disc = b84.groupby('household_key')[['coupon_disc','retail_disc','coupon_match_disc']].sum().sum(1)
    out['disc_share_84'] = -disc/out['spend_84'].replace(0,np.nan)

    # zero-value line share
    zl = (b84['sales_value']==0).groupby(b84['household_key']).mean()

    # private brand share — need products merge
    prod = view.table('products')[['product_id','brand','department']]
    b84b = b84.merge(prod, on='product_id', how='left')
    pb = b84b[b84b.brand=='Private'].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    out['private_share_84'] = pb/out['spend_84'].replace(0,np.nan)

    # dept shares (a few)
    for dep in ['GROCERY','DRUG GM','PRODUCE','MEAT','DELI','PASTRY','COSMETICS']:
        ds = b84b[b84b.department==dep].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
        out['dep_%s_84'%dep[:6].replace(' ','')] = ds/out['spend_84'].replace(0,np.nan)

    # repeat product rate
    p84 = set per hh of products in 84d with spend; pprev = products in (end-365, end-84]
    overlap spend share: for each hh, sum of sales in 84d on products also in pprev / spend_84.
    Implementation: p84s = b84.groupby(['household_key','product_id'])['sales_value'].sum(); prev = t[(t.day>end-365)&(t.day<=end-84)].groupby(['household_key','product_id']).size()
    join on index; share = sum(sales where prev>0)/spend_84

    # store loyalty
    ss = b84.groupby(['household_key','store_id'])['sales_value'].sum()
    out['top_store_share_84'] = ss.groupby('household_key').max()/out['spend_84'].replace(0,np.nan)

    # seasonal

def feats(view, snapshot_day):
    end = snapshot_day
    t = view.table('transactions'); t = t[t.day<=end]
    hh_all = view.households  # index
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh_all)

    # daily spend
    daily = t.groupby(['household_key','day'])['sales_value'].sum()

    # window sums helper
    def wsum(lo):  # (end-lo, end]
        return t[(t.day>end-lo)&(t.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()

    for name, lo in [('spend_7',7),('spend_14',14),('spend_28',28),('spend_56',56),('spend_84',84),('spend_180',180),('spend_365',365)]:
        out[name] = wsum(lo)
    out['spend_28_prior'] = t[(t.day>end-56)&(t.day<=end-28)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    out['spend_84_prior'] = t[(t.day>end-168)&(t.day<=end-84)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()

    # ew decays on daily spend
    d = daily.reset_index(); d['age'] = end - d['day']
    for hl in [7,14,28,56,84,180]:
        wgt = 0.5**(d['age']/hl)
        out['ew_%d'%hl] = (d['sales_value']*wgt).groupby(d['household_key']).sum()

    # lags: spend in (end-lag-28, end-lag]
    for lag in [336,364,392]:
        out['spend_lag%d'%lag] = t[(t.day>end-lag-28)&(t.day<=end-lag)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()

    total = t.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    first_day = t.groupby('household_key')['day'].min()
    tenure_wk = ((end - first_day)/7.0).replace(0, np.nan)
    out['longrun_wk'] = total/tenure_wk
    out['ratio28_lr'] = out['spend_28']/(out['longrun_wk']*4).replace(0,np.nan)
    out['ratio84_lr'] = out['spend_84']/(out['longrun_wk']*12).replace(0,np.nan)

    # baskets
    b84 = t[(t.day>end-84)&(t.day<=end)]
    bsum = b84.groupby(['household_key','basket_id'])['sales_value'].sum()
    bcnt = bsum.groupby('household_key').agg(baskets_84='size', basket_max_84='max', basket_std_84='std', basket_med_84='median')
    out = out.join(bcnt)
    out['baskets_28'] = t[(t.day>end-28)&(t.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique()
    out['baskets_14'] = t[(t.day>end-14)&(t.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique()
    out['baskets_7'] = t[(t.day>end-7)&(t.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique()

    last = t.groupby('household_key')['day'].max()
    out['days_since_last'] = end - last
    out['days_since_first'] = end - first_day
    out['avg_basket_84'] = out['spend_84']/out['baskets_84'].replace(0,np.nan)
    out['trips_per_wk_84'] = out['baskets_84']/12.0
    out['spend_28_ratio'] = out['spend_28']/out['spend_28_prior'].replace(0,np.nan)
    out['n_products_84'] = b84.groupby('household_key')['product_id'].nunique()
    out['n_stores_84'] = b84.groupby('household_key')['store_id'].nunique()
    out['spend_trend'] = (out['spend_28']-out['spend_28_prior'])/28.0
    out['active_28'] = (out['baskets_28']>0).astype(float)

    # active days
    out['active_days_28'] = t[(t.day>end-28)&(t.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['day'].nunique()
    out['active_days_14'] = t[(t.day>end-14)&(t.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['day'].nunique()

    # gaps over trailing 180d trip days
    td = t[(t.day>end-180)&(t.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['day'].unique()
    gaps = td.apply(lambda a: np.diff(np.sort(a)) if len(a)>1 else np.array([]))
    out['gap_mean_180'] = gaps.apply(lambda a: a.mean() if len(a)>0 else np.nan)
    out['gap_cv'] = gaps.apply(lambda a: (a.std()/a.mean()) if len(a)>1 and a.mean()>0 else np.nan)
    out['max_gap_180'] = gaps.apply(lambda a: a.max() if len(a)>0 else np.nan)
    out['recency_ratio'] = out['days_since_last']/out['gap_mean_180']

    # zero weeks in trailing 26w
    blk = ((end - t['day'])//7)
    tb = t.assign(blk=blk)
    wk_spend = tb[tb.blk<26].groupby(['household_key','blk'])['sales_value'].sum()
    active_blocks = wk_spend.groupby('household_key').size()
    out['zero_weeks_26'] = 1 - active_blocks/26.0

    # basket trajectory
    b28 = t[(t.day>end-28)&(t.day<=end)].groupby(['household_key','basket_id'])['sales_value'].sum()
    ab28 = b28.groupby('household_key').mean()
    out['avg_basket_28'] = ab28
    out['basket_28_vs_84'] = out['avg_basket_28']/out['avg_basket_84']

    # lines per basket, quantity per basket (84d)
    lines = b84.groupby('household_key').size()
    out['lines_per_basket_84'] = lines/out['baskets_84'].replace(0,np.nan)
    qty = b84.groupby('household_key')['quantity'].sum()
    out['units_per_basket_84'] = qty/out['baskets_84'].replace(0,np.nan)
    out['unit_price_84'] = out['spend_84']/qty.replace(0,np.nan)

    # discount share
    disc = b84.groupby('household_key')[['coupon_disc','retail_disc','coupon_match_disc']].sum().sum(1)
    out['disc_share_84'] = -disc/out['spend_84'].replace(0,np.nan)

    # zero-value line share
    zl = (b84['sales_value']==0).groupby(b84['household_key']).mean()

    # private brand share — need products merge
    prod = view.table('products')[['product_id','brand','department']]
    b84b = b84.merge(prod, on='product_id', how='left')
    pb = b84b[b84b.brand=='Private'].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    out['private_share_84'] = pb/out['spend_84'].replace(0,np.nan)

    # dept shares (a few)
    for dep in ['GROCERY','DRUG GM','PRODUCE','MEAT','DELI','PASTRY','COSMETICS']:
        ds = b84b[b84b.department==dep].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
        out['dep_%s_84'%dep[:6].replace(' ','')] = ds/out['spend_84'].replace(0,np.nan)

    # repeat product rate
    p84 = set per hh of products in 84d with spend; pprev = products in (end-365, end-84]
    overlap spend share: for each hh, sum of sales in 84d on products also in pprev / spend_84.
    Implementation: p84s = b84.groupby(['household_key','product_id'])['sales_value'].sum(); prev = t[(t.day>end-365)&(t.day<=end-84)].groupby(['household_key','product_id']).size()
    join on index; share = sum(sales where prev>0)/spend_84

    # store loyalty
    ss = b84.groupby(['household_key','store_id'])['sales_value'].sum()
    out['top_store_share_84'] = ss.groupby('household_key').max()/out['spend_84'].replace(0,np.nan)

    # seasonal
    out['sin_y'] = np.sin(2*np.pi*end/364); out['cos_y'] = np.cos(2*np.pi*end/364)
    out['sin_q'] = np.sin(2*np.pi*end/91); out['cos_q'] = np.cos(2*np.pi*end/91)
    out['day_idx'] = end/100.0

    # interactions
    out['ix_ew28_trips'] = out['ew_28']*out['trips_per_wk_84']
    out['ix_spend84_active'] = out['spend_84']*out['active_28']
    out['ix_recency_ew'] = out['ew_28']*np.exp(-out['days_since_last']/28)

    out = out.reindex(hh_all)
    return out

def ridge_cv(feats, vals=(375,403,431), lams=(3,10,30,100,300)):
    X_all = df[feats].astype(float)
    med = X_all.median()
    X_all = X_all.fillna(med).values
    yv = df['future_spend_4w'].values
    days = df['snapshot_day'].values
    out={}
    for lam in lams:
        maes=[]
        for v in vals:
            tr = days < v; va = days == v
            Xtr, ytr = X_all[tr], yv[tr]
            mu, sd = Xtr.mean(0), Xtr.std(0)+1e-9
            Xtr_s = (Xtr-mu)/sd; Xva_s = (X_all[va]-mu)/sd
            A = Xtr_s.T@Xtr_s + lam*np.eye(len(feats))
            b = Xtr_s.T@ytr
            w = np.linalg.solve(A,b)
            p = np.clip(Xva_s@w, 0, None)
            maes.append(np.abs(p-yv[va]).mean())
        out[lam]=np.mean(maes)
    return out
print(ridge_cv(feats))
```

def ridge_cv(flist, vals=(347,375,403,431), lams=(1,3,10,30,100,300,1000), logt=False):
    Xa = df[flist].astype(float)
    Xa = Xa.fillna(Xa.median())
    A = Xa.values
    yv = y.copy()
    if logt: yv = np.log1p(yv)
    days = df['snapshot_day'].values
    res={}
    for lam in lams:
        ms=[]
        for v in vals:
            tr = days < v; va = days == v
            Xtr = A[tr]; 
            mu = Xtr.mean(0); sd = Xtr.std(0)+1e-9
            Xtr_s = (Xtr-mu)/sd; Xva_s = (A[va]-mu)/sd
            ytr = yv[tr]; yb = ytr.mean()
            w = np.linalg.solve(Xtr_s.T@Xtr_s + lam*np.eye(len(flist)), Xtr_s.T@(ytr-yb))
            p = Xva_s@w + yb
            if logt: p = np.expm1(p)
            p = np.clip(p, 0, None)
            ms.append(np.abs(p - y[va]).mean())
        res[lam]=round(float(np.mean(ms)),3)
    return res

print("e5 raw:", ridge_cv(feats))
print("e5 log:", ridge_cv(feats, logt=True))

def ridge_cv(feats, vals=(375,403,431), lams=(3,10,30,100,300)):
    X_all = df[feats].astype(float)
    med = X_all.median()
    X_all = X_all.fillna(med).values
    yv = df['future_spend_4w'].values
    days = df['snapshot_day'].values
    out={}
    for lam in lams:
        maes=[]
        for v in vals:
            tr = days < v; va = days == v
            Xtr, ytr = X_all[tr], yv[tr]
            mu, sd = Xtr.mean(0), Xtr.std(0)+1e-9
            Xtr_s = (Xtr-mu)/sd; Xva_s = (X_all[va]-mu)/sd
            A = Xtr_s.T@Xtr_s + lam*np.eye(len(feats))
            b = Xtr_s.T@ytr
            w = np.linalg.solve(A,b)
            p = np.clip(Xva_s@w, 0, None)
            maes.append(np.abs(p-yv[va]).mean())
        out[lam]=np.mean(maes)
    return out
print(ridge_cv(feats))
```

def ridge_cv(flist, vals=(347,375,403,431), lams=(1,3,10,30,100,300,1000), logt=False):
    Xa = df[flist].astype(float)
    Xa = Xa.fillna(Xa.median())
    A = Xa.values
    yv = y.copy()
    if logt: yv = np.log1p(yv)
    days = df['snapshot_day'].values
    res={}
    for lam in lams:
        ms=[]
        for v in vals:
            tr = days < v; va = days == v
            Xtr = A[tr]; 
            mu = Xtr.mean(0); sd = Xtr.std(0)+1e-9
            Xtr_s = (Xtr-mu)/sd; Xva_s = (A[va]-mu)/sd
            ytr = yv[tr]; yb = ytr.mean()
            w = np.linalg.solve(Xtr_s.T@Xtr_s + lam*np.eye(len(flist)), Xtr_s.T@(ytr-yb))
            p = Xva_s@w + yb
            if logt: p = np.expm1(p)
            p = np.clip(p, 0, None)
            ms.append(np.abs(p - y[va]).mean())
        res[lam]=round(float(np.mean(ms)),3)
    return res

print("e5 raw:", ridge_cv(feats))
print("e5 log:", ridge_cv(feats, logt=True))

import agent_api, pandas as pd, numpy as np

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    hh = view.households
    hh_idx = pd.Index(hh)
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    tx = tx[tx.household_key.isin(hh_idx)]
    day = tx['day'].values
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh_idx)

    def spend_in(lo, hi):
        m = (day > lo) & (day <= hi)
        if not m.any():
            return pd.Series(0.0, index=hh_idx)
        s = tx.loc[m].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
        return s.reindex(hh_idx).fillna(0.0)

    def baskets_in(lo, hi):
        m = (day > lo) & (day <= hi)
        if not m.any():
            return pd.Series(0.0, index=hh_idx)
        s = tx.loc[m].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique()
        return s.reindex(hh_idx).fillna(0.0)

    out['spend_28_prior2'] = spend_in(snapshot_day-84, snapshot_day-56)
    out['spend_28_prior3'] = spend_in(snapshot_day-112, snapshot_day-84)
    b28 = baskets_in(snapshot_day-28, snapshot_day)
    b84 = baskets_in(snapshot_day-84, snapshot_day)
    out['trip_freq_ratio'] = b28 / (b84*(28/84) + 0.5)

    # median of trailing 28d windows over 182d
    first_day = tx.groupby('household_key')['day'].min().reindex(hh_idx)
    wins = []
    for k in range(1, 7):
        w = spend_in(snapshot_day-28*k, snapshot_day-28*(k-1))
        wins.append(w)
    W = pd.concat(wins, axis=1)
    starts = np.array([snapshot_day-28*k for k in range(1,7)])
    mask = starts[None,:] >= first_day.values[:,None]  # window fully after first purchase
    W = W.where(mask)
    out['med28_182'] = W.median(axis=1, skipna=True)

    # household seasonal index for target window
    wk = tx['week_no'].values
    wy = (wk - 1) % 52
    twys = np.array(sorted({(((dd+8)//7) - 1) % 52 for dd in range(snapshot_day+1, snapshot_day+29)}))
    m = np.isin(wy, twys)
    sm = tx.loc[m].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum().reindex(hh_idx).fillna(0.0)
    sa = tx.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum().reindex(hh_idx).fillna(0.0)
    span = (snapshot_day - first_day).clip(lower=1)
    exp_share = len(twys)/52.0
    idx = sm / (sa * exp_share).replace(0, np.nan)
    out['hh_seasonal_index'] = idx.where(span >= 180)
    return out
```

import agent_api, pandas as pd, numpy as np

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    hh = view.households
    hh_idx = pd.Index(hh)
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    tx = tx[tx.household_key.isin(hh_idx)]
    day = tx['day'].values
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh_idx)

    def spend_in(lo, hi):
        m = (day > lo) & (day <= hi)
        if not m.any():
            return pd.Series(0.0, index=hh_idx)
        s = tx.loc[m].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
        return s.reindex(hh_idx).fillna(0.0)

    def baskets_in(lo, hi):
        m = (day > lo) & (day <= hi)
        if not m.any():
            return pd.Series(0.0, index=hh_idx)
        s = tx.loc[m].groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique()
        return s.reindex(hh_idx).fillna(0.0)

    out['spend_28_prior2'] = spend_in(snapshot_day-84, snapshot_day-56)
    out['spend_28_prior3'] = spend_in(snapshot_day-112, snapshot_day-84)
    b28 = baskets_in(snapshot_day-28, snapshot_day)
    b84 = baskets_in(snapshot_day-84, snapshot_day)
    out['trip_freq_ratio'] = b28 / (b84*(28/84) + 0.5)

    # median of trailing 28d windows over 182d
    first_day = tx.groupby('household_key')['day'].min().reindex(hh_idx)
    wins = []
    for k in range(1, 7):
        w = spend_in(snapshot_day-28*k, snapshot_day-28*(k-1))
        wins.append(w)
    W = pd.concat(wins, axis=1)
    starts = np.array([snapshot_day-28*k for k in range(1,7)])
    mask = starts[None,:] >= first_day.values[:,None]  # window fully after first purchase
    W = W.where(mask)
    out['med28_182'] = W.median(axis=1, skipna=True)

    # household seasonal index for target window
    wk = tx['week_no'].values
    wy = (wk - 1) % 52
    twys = np.array(sorted({(((dd+8)//7) - 1) % 52 for dd in range(snapshot_day+1, snapshot_day+29)}))
    m = np.isin(wy, twys)
    sm = tx.loc[m].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum().reindex(hh_idx).fillna(0.0)
    sa = tx.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum().reindex(hh_idx).fillna(0.0)
    span = (snapshot_day - first_day).clip(lower=1)
    exp_share = len(twys)/52.0
    idx = sm / (sa * exp_share).replace(0, np.nan)
    out['hh_seasonal_index'] = idx.where(span >= 180)

    ks = np.arange(18)

def build(view, snapshot_day):
    hh = view.households
    if isinstance(hh, pd.DataFrame):
        keys = pd.Index(hh["household_key"], name="household_key")
    else:
        keys = pd.Index(np.asarray(hh).ravel(), name="household_key")
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    tx = tx[tx["day"] <= snapshot_day]
    tx = tx[tx["household_key"].isin(set(keys))]  # limit
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=keys)
    # weekly spends
    for k in range(1,9):
        hi = snapshot_day - 7*(k-1); lo = snapshot_day - 7*k
        m = tx[(tx["day"]>lo)&(tx["day"]<=hi)]
        out[f"wk_{k}"] = m.groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum().reindex(keys).fillna(0.0).values
    ...

Wait reindex(keys) then .values — index alignment fine.

    g = tx.groupby("household_key")
    last = g["day"].max().reindex(keys)
    out["dsl_trip"] = (snapshot_day - last).fillna(999).values

    # 84d slice
    tx84 = tx[tx["day"] > snapshot_day-84]
    g84 = tx84.groupby("household_key")
    out["n_products_84"] = g84["product_id"].nunique().reindex(keys).fillna(0).values
    out["n_stores_84"] = g84["store_id"].nunique().reindex(keys).fillna(0).values
    # departments via products
    pr = view.table("products")[["product_id","department"]]
    txp = tx84.merge(pr, on="product_id", how="left")
    out["n_depts_84"] = txp.groupby("household_key")["department"].nunique().reindex(keys).fillna(0).values
    # top store share
    st = tx84.groupby(["household_key","store_id"]).size().rename("n").reset_index()
    tot = st.groupby("household_key")["n"].transform("sum")
    st["share"] = st["n"]/tot
    top = st.groupby("household_key")["share"].max().reindex(keys).fillna(0).values
    out["top_store_share_84"] = top
    # unit price & promo
    disc = tx84[["household_key","sales_value","quantity","coupon_disc","coupon_match_disc","retail_disc"]].copy()
    dsum = (disc["coupon_disc"].fillna(0)+disc["coupon_match_disc"].fillna(0)+disc["retail_disc"].fillna(0))
    # sign: assume discounts negative; promo amount = -dsum clipped at 0
    promo = (-dsum).clip(lower=0)
    agg = disc.assign(promo=promo).groupby("household_key").agg(sales=("sales_value","sum"), qty=("quantity","sum"), promo=("promo","sum"))
    out["unit_price_84"] = (agg["sales"]/agg["qty"].replace(0,np.nan)).reindex(keys).values
    out["promo_share_84"] = (agg["promo"]/(agg["sales"]+agg["promo"]).replace(0,np.nan)).reindex(keys).values
    # baskets
    b = tx84.groupby(["household_key","basket_id"])["sales_value"].sum()
    bb = b.groupby("household_key").agg(["max","mean","count"])
    out["max_basket_84"] = bb["max"].reindex(keys).values
    out["mean_basket_84"] = bb["mean"].reindex(keys).values
    # qty per trip 28
    tx28 = tx[tx["day"]>snapshot_day-28]
    q28 = tx28.groupby("household_key").agg(q=("quantity","sum"), t=("basket_id","nunique"))
    out["qty_per_trip_28"] = (q28["q"]/q28["t"].replace(0,np.nan)).reindex(keys).values
    # active weeks 12
    W = (snapshot_day+8)//7
    w84 = tx84[(tx84["week_no"]>W-12)&(tx84["week_no"]<=W)]
    out["active_weeks_12"] = w84.groupby("household_key")["week_no"].nunique().reindex(keys).fillna(0).values
    # active 28d windows in 364d
    tx364 = tx[tx["day"]>snapshot_day-364]
    wb = ((snapshot_day - tx364["day"])//28)  # 0..12
    aw = tx364.assign(wb=wb).groupby("household_key")["wb"].nunique().reindex(keys).fillna(0)
    out["active_windows_13"] = aw.values
    # gap max 364
    d2 = tx364[["household_key","day"]].drop_duplicates().sort_values(["household_key","day"])
    gaps = d2.groupby("household_key")["day"].diff()
    gm = d2.assign(g=gaps).groupby("household_key")["g"].max()
    out["gap_max_364"] = gm.reindex(keys).values
    # ratio recent vs long-run weekly
    s28 = tx28.groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum().reindex(keys).fillna(0)
    s364 = tx364.groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum().reindex(keys).fillna(0)
    lr_week = (s364/52.0)
    out["ratio28_lrweek"] = (s28/(4*lr_week).replace(0,np.nan)).values
    return out

    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    disc = tx["coupon_disc"] + tx["coupon_match_disc"] + tx["retail_disc"]  # <=0 mostly

    for W, suf in [(84,"84"), (364,"364")]:
        m = tx["day"] > snapshot_day - W
        t = tx[m]
        g = t.groupby("household_key")
        sp = g["sales_value"].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
        ds = g["_disc"].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
        out["rd_"+suf] = g["retail_disc"].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
        out["cd_"+suf] = g["coupon_disc"].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
        out["disc_share_"+suf] = (-ds) / (sp + (-ds)).replace(0, np.nan)
        cb = t[t["coupon_disc"] < 0].groupby("household_key")["basket_id"].nunique().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
        nb = g["basket_id"].nunique().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
        out["coup_trips_"+suf] = cb
        if suf == "364":
            out["coup_trip_share_364"] = cb / nb.replace(0, np.nan)
            out["net_spend_364"] = sp + ds
            out["units_per_trip_364"] = np.log1p(g["quantity"].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0) / nb.replace(0, np.nan))
        else:
            out["coup_trips_84"] = cb
    cr = view.table("coupon_redemptions")
    cr = cr[cr["household_key"].isin(set(hh))]
    gcr = cr.groupby("household_key")
    out["days_since_redem"] = (snapshot_day - gcr["day"].max()).reindex(hh)  # NaN if never
    m84 = cr["day"] > snapshot_day - 84
    out["redem_84"] = cr[m84].groupby("household_key")["day"].count().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out["snap_day"] = snapshot_day  # not needed; e10 has it
    return out

feats = agent_api.build_features(build)

import agent_api as api, numpy as np, pandas as pd

df = api.load_saved("e011_discounts.parquet")
tt = api.train_targets()  # household_key, snapshot_day, future_spend_4w

# per-household aggregates over train snapshots
g = tt.groupby("household_key").future_spend_4w
stats = pd.DataFrame({
    "hh_mean": g.mean(),
    "hh_std": g.std(),
    "hh_n": g.count(),
})
# sum for LOO
ssum = g.sum().rename("hh_sum")
stats = stats.join(ssum)

df = df.merge(stats.reset_index(), on="household_key", how="left")
df = df.merge(tt[["household_key","snapshot_day","future_spend_4w"]].rename(columns={"future_spend_4w":"tgt"}),
              on=["household_key","snapshot_day"], how="left")

is_train = df.tgt.notna()
n = df.hh_n
df["hh_mean_loo"] = np.where(is_train & (n>1), (df.hh_sum - df.tgt)/(n-1), df.hh_mean)
# causal: mean over strictly earlier snapshots
tt_sorted = tt.sort_values(["household_key","snapshot_day"])
tt_sorted["cumsum"] = tt_sorted.groupby("household_key").future_spend_4w.cumsum()

import agent_api as A, pandas as pd, numpy as np
t = A.load_saved('e011_discounts.parquet')
tt = A.train_targets()
m = tt.merge(t, on=['household_key','snapshot_day'])
y = m['future_spend_4w'].values.astype(float)
feat_cols = [c for c in t.columns if c not in ('household_key','snapshot_day')]
X = m[feat_cols].copy()
# encode non-numeric as category codes
for c in feat_cols:
    if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(X[c]):
        X[c] = X[c].astype('category').cat.codes.replace(-1, np.nan)
Xv = X.values.astype(float)
# standardize
mu = np.nanmean(Xv, axis=0); sd = np.nanstd(Xv, axis=0); sd[sd==0]=1
Xz = (Xv-mu)/sd
Xz = np.nan_to_num(Xz)
train_snap = [95,123,151,179,207,235,263,291,319,347,375,403]
val_snap = [459,487,515,543]
tr = m.snapshot_day.isin(train_snap).values
va = m.snapshot_day.isin(val_snap).values
def ridge_fit(X, y, alpha):
    n, p = X.shape
    A_ = X.T@X + alpha*np.eye(p)
    b = X.T@y
    return np.linalg.solve(A_, b)
def mae(X, y, w): return np.abs(X@w - y).mean()
# add intercept
Xz1 = np.hstack([Xz, np.ones((Xz.shape[0],1))])
# pick alpha on pseudo-val: fit on train snaps except 431, eval 431
tr2 = tr & (m.snapshot_day!=431)
pv = (m.snapshot_day==431).values
best=None
for a in [0.1,1,10,100,300,1000,3000,10000]:
    w = ridge_fit(Xz1[tr2], y[tr2], a)
    v = mae(Xz1[pv], y[pv], w)
    if best is None or v<best[1]: best=(a,v)
print('pseudo-val best alpha', best)
w = ridge_fit(Xz1[tr], y[tr], best[0])
print('ridge val MAE', mae(Xz1[va], y[va], w))
# OLS
w_ols, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Xz1[tr], y[tr], rcond=None)
print('ols val MAE', mae(Xz1[va], y[va], w_ols))
# log version: log1p transform numeric spend-like cols
Xl = X.copy()
for c in feat_cols:
    col = X[c]
    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(col) and (col>=-1e-9).all():
        Xl[c] = np.log1p(col)
Xlv = Xl.values.astype(float)
mul = np.nanmean(Xlv,0); sdl = np.nanstd(Xlv,0); sdl[sdl==0]=1
Xlz = np.nan_to_num((Xlv-mul)/sdl)
Xlz1 = np.hstack([Xlz, np.ones((Xlz.shape[0],1))])
w = ridge_fit(Xlz1[tr2], y[tr2], best[0])
print('ridge-log pseudo MAE', mae(Xlz1[pv], y[pv], w))
w = ridge_fit(Xlz1[tr], y[tr], best[0])
print('ridge-log val MAE', mae(Xlz1[va], y[va], w))
```

import agent_api as A, pandas as pd, numpy as np
t = A.load_saved('e011_discounts.parquet')
tt = A.train_targets()
m = tt.merge(t, on=['household_key','snapshot_day'])
y = m['future_spend_4w'].values.astype(float)
feat_cols = [c for c in t.columns if c not in ('household_key','snapshot_day')]
X = m[feat_cols].copy()
# encode non-numeric as category codes
for c in feat_cols:
    if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(X[c]):
        X[c] = X[c].astype('category').cat.codes.replace(-1, np.nan)
Xv = X.values.astype(float)
# standardize
mu = np.nanmean(Xv, axis=0); sd = np.nanstd(Xv, axis=0); sd[sd==0]=1
Xz = (Xv-mu)/sd
Xz = np.nan_to_num(Xz)
train_snap = [95,123,151,179,207,235,263,291,319,347,375,403]
val_snap = [459,487,515,543]
tr = m.snapshot_day.isin(train_snap).values
va = m.snapshot_day.isin(val_snap).values
def ridge_fit(X, y, alpha):
    n, p = X.shape
    A_ = X.T@X + alpha*np.eye(p)
    b = X.T@y
    return np.linalg.solve(A_, b)
def mae(X, y, w): return np.abs(X@w - y).mean()
# add intercept
Xz1 = np.hstack([Xz, np.ones((Xz.shape[0],1))])
# pick alpha on pseudo-val: fit on train snaps except 431, eval 431
tr2 = tr & (m.snapshot_day!=431)
pv = (m.snapshot_day==431).values
best=None
for a in [0.1,1,10,100,300,1000,3000,10000]:
    w = ridge_fit(Xz1[tr2], y[tr2], a)
    v = mae(Xz1[pv], y[pv], w)
    if best is None or v<best[1]: best=(a,v)
print('pseudo-val best alpha', best)
w = ridge_fit(Xz1[tr], y[tr], best[0])
print('ridge val MAE', mae(Xz1[va], y[va], w))
# OLS
w_ols, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Xz1[tr], y[tr], rcond=None)
print('ols val MAE', mae(Xz1[va], y[va], w_ols))
# log version: log1p transform numeric spend-like cols
Xl = X.copy()
for c in feat_cols:
    col = X[c]
    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(col) and (col>=-1e-9).all():
        Xl[c] = np.log1p(col)
Xlv = Xl.values.astype(float)
mul = np.nanmean(Xlv,0); sdl = np.nanstd(Xlv,0); sdl[sdl==0]=1
Xlz = np.nan_to_num((Xlv-mul)/sdl)
Xlz1 = np.hstack([Xlz, np.ones((Xlz.shape[0],1))])
w = ridge_fit(Xlz1[tr2], y[tr2], best[0])
print('ridge-log pseudo MAE', mae(Xlz1[pv], y[pv], w))
w = ridge_fit(Xlz1[tr], y[tr], best[0])
print('ridge-log val MAE', mae(Xlz1[va], y[va], w))
```

import agent_api as A, pandas as pd, numpy as np, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

def bin_features(X, n_bins=32):
    # X: 2d float array with NaNs
    n, p = X.shape
    binned = np.zeros((n, p), dtype=np.int32)
    bin_edges = []
    nan_code = n_bins  # extra bin for NaN
    for j in range(p):
        x = X[:, j]
        ok = ~np.isnan(x)
        if ok.sum() == 0:
            binned[:, j] = nan_code
            bin_edges.append(None)
            continue
        qs = np.quantile(x[ok], np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins+1)[1:-1])
        edges = np.unique(qs)
        b = np.searchsorted(edges, x[ok], side='right')
        bb = np.full(n, nan_code, dtype=np.int32)
        bb[ok] = b
        binned[:, j] = bb
        bin_edges.append(edges)
    return binned, bin_edges
```

import agent_api as A, pandas as pd, numpy as np, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

def bin_features(X, n_bins=32):
    # X: 2d float array with NaNs
    n, p = X.shape
    binned = np.zeros((n, p), dtype=np.int32)
    bin_edges = []
    nan_code = n_bins  # extra bin for NaN
    for j in range(p):
        x = X[:, j]
        ok = ~np.isnan(x)
        if ok.sum() == 0:
            binned[:, j] = nan_code
            bin_edges.append(None)
            continue
        qs = np.quantile(x[ok], np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins+1)[1:-1])
        edges = np.unique(qs)
        b = np.searchsorted(edges, x[ok], side='right')
        bb = np.full(n, nan_code, dtype=np.int32)
        bb[ok] = b
        binned[:, j] = bb
        bin_edges.append(edges)
    return binned, bin_edges
```

Diagnostics:
- `index` is just a row counter (0..36421) — harmless-ish; removing it slightly worsens proxy (66.9 vs 66.3), noise. Keep or drop, minor.
- log-target slightly better on proxy (65.73 vs 66.31). The real evaluator's model is fixed though — I can't change its loss. So log-target won't apply to the real eval. Skip.
- Error structure: big errors on high spenders (y 400+: MAE 174) and mid; zeros are predicted 41 on average (497 zero rows contribute ~41*497/2497 ≈ 8.2 MAE). Better zero handling could shave a few points.
- dsl[0,7) MAE 81 — the bulk. High spenders are hard.

Now, what do I do with the 8 experiments? The fixed evaluator model matters. Let me think about what the harness likely uses: a fixed regression model — possibly sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor or RandomForest, or Ridge. R² is also reported. E009 (5 features only) got 66.7 — much worse than E005's 63.3 with 37. If the model were a GBM, 5 AR features would still capture much of the signal (ew_28-like). E009 had spend_28_prior2/3, trip_freq_ratio, med28_182, hh_seasonal_index — no recent spend at all! spend_28_prior2 = 28d window 2 back. That's why it's bad. Not informative about model type.

E012: adding 5 target-encoding features to 78 → 72.2. If model = linear (ridge), adding hh_mean_loo (corr 0.834, near-duplicate of ew_28) could destabilize via collinearity... but ridge handles collinearity. The NaN issue: at validation, hh_mean_loo etc. are ALL NaN. If the evaluator's model is sklearn HistGradientBoosting, NaNs are handled natively (learned default direction) — then 100%-NaN columns at val are handled but useless; wouldn't cause +9.5 MAE. If the model is RandomForest (sklearn), NaNs are NOT supported → would error, not degrade. If it's Ridge with imputation... maybe impute with train medians: hh_mean_loo val median ≈ train median ~137; filling 137 for all val rows adds a constant-ish collinear column — ridge would shrink it. Hmm, +9.5 MAE seems too big for that.

Alternative: the evaluator may be a GBM with limited depth/trees where a noisy high-cardinality-ish feature (hh_mean_loo is continuous, household-level) gets overfit on train (it perfectly memorizes household means — train corr 0.834, higher than ew_28's 0.827!). A GBM would heavily split on it, memorizing household-level train means, which don't transfer (households in val are the same households though!). Wait — val households ARE the same households (same ~2500 hh, later snapshots). So hh_mean_loo at val (computed from past targets only) would still be informative... but it was NaN at val! If the harness imputes NaN with something (e.g., 0 or train median), the model splits on hh_mean_loo and sends all val rows down the "missing/median" path → garbage. That explains +9.5.

Lesson reinforced: every feature must be computable at validation (no NaN-by-design at val). Also avoid features that memorize (LOO encodings).

So the fixed model: unknown, but handles NaN somehow (E011 has NaN-heavy features like spend_lag392 97% NaN and got 62.65 fine). Possibly HistGradientBoostingRegressor. HGB handles NaN natively. And HGB with 200 trees, depth 3-ish on 26k rows, 78 features — plausible.

1. **Zero/intermittency handling**: two-part features that help the model separate zeros: already have dsl, active_28. Maybe add "expected_spend" style features: ew_28 already. Marginal.

Additional useful: spend in trailing 4 weeks *same household last year* (lag 364) — have spend_lag364 (93% NaN — most households don't have 364d history at early snapshots; at later snapshots they do). Hmm, at snapshot 95, day-364 history doesn't exist. NaN rate 93% overall.

Features like hh-level mean of ew_28 across *past snapshots only* (computable at val!) — i.e., "typical ew_28 for this household as of earlier snapshots". This is like a causal version of E012's hh_mean_causal — but computed from *features* (ew_28 values at past snapshots), not targets. Is that allowed? I'd need, inside fn(view, snapshot_day), to compute ew_28 for each household at past snapshot days (95..snapshot-28) — I CAN: view has all transactions up to snapshot_day; past snapshot days are all ≤ snapshot_day. So compute ew_28 at day 95, 123, ..., snapshot_day-28 from the same view. That's legitimate — uses only data ≤ snapshot_day. This gives "household's typical recent-spend level" — a shrunk version of ew_28. Could help GBM by providing a stable household level feature. But is it redundant with ew_84/ew_180/longrun_wk? Somewhat — ew_180 and longrun_wk already average ~6 months/1yr. The unique bit: ew_28 measured at *previous 28d-aligned points* = exactly the lag-28/56/112 values of the ew_28 series. E009's spend_28_prior2/3 were similar (lag windows) and E009 was bad — but E009 dropped ALL the strong features. Adding lags ON TOP of E011 is different. E004 added spend_lag336/364/392 on top of E001 → 63.574→63.405 (tiny gain). Hmm, so lags added little.

4. **Perishable/fresh vs stock-up behavior**: e.g., share of spend on perishables predicts regularity. Dept shares exist in E002 but were dropped from E011? E011 has no dept features (E002 added them, but E010 lineage: E010 built on E005 which built on E004←E001 — E002/E003's mix/marketing features were dropped!). 6. **Basket size trajectory**: E008 tested (63.507 vs E005 63.318) — no gain.

7. **Interaction/recency-weighted trend**: slope features exist. 

8. **Two-part modeling via features**: add features that let the fixed model handle zeros better: e.g., "p_active" = historical fraction of 28d windows with any purchase (over trailing year); "zero_run" = consecutive prior windows with zero spend. lr_active_wins exists (fraction of active windows in trailing year). zero_run is new: number of consecutive 28d windows (ending at snapshot) with zero spend. 2. Marketing features (E003) didn't help either (63.725).

3. Store behavior — store diversity, number of distinct stores, share at primary store. Could be mildly informative.

4. Seasonality interactions — E008 slightly worse.

5. Better handling: maybe non-linear model? No — the model is fixed. We can only change features.

6. Feature engineering on the target scale: the model is a fixed regression (probably gradient boosting or linear?). Unknown. Given MAE ~62 and target distribution, likely a GBM. Feature importance matters.

7. Maybe add interactions: e.g., spend_28 * trend, recency-weighted by gap. Or "days since last purchase" — check whether E010 includes that. E010: "tenure-robust trailing-year window stats (lr_mean/med/std/max/min28, ..." plus presumably days_since_last. E004 had lag features. E005 has gap_cv.

8. Perhaps a key missing signal: spend at the same snapshot-day lag (lag-364 = same season last year) — E004 added lag-336/364/392. Already there.

9. Household-level "future spend" is highly correlated with recent spend; the model probably saturates. Marginal gains come from variance reduction.

10. Another idea: quantile/robust aggregates of basket sizes, distinct products, distinct departments, top-N product concentration (e.g., share of spend in household's top-5 products), repeat-purchase rate, new-product share (exploration). Could add.

11. Store features: n_stores_84, primary store share, store entropy. Plus maybe store's average spend? Store-level aggregation could be noisy.

12. Coupon redemption recency: coupon_redemptions in last 28d count, campaign targeting recency (days since targeted campaign start). E003 added marketing but slightly worse.

13. Time-of-day features: trans_time patterns (morning vs evening shopper). Probably weak.

14. Quantity vs sales_value: average unit price paid (sales_value/quantity), share of spend on discounted items, price tier. Could capture trade-down behavior. E011 covered discounts.

15. Week_no alignment: display_mailer exposure for products the household buys — E003 included display/mailer features and didn't help.

16. Cross-household priors: household-level mean spend by demographics — but demographics only cover 1/3.

17. Snapshot-day interaction: spend patterns vary by snapshot day (seasonality). The model can learn day effects from snapshot_day itself (E000 had day index). Maybe add snapshot-week-of-year already there.

18. A promising angle: target is 4-week future spend. The strongest predictor is recent 4-week spend. The model may underfit extremes. Adding features that help calibrate: e.g., ratio of spend_28 to spend_84 (stability), zero-spend probability proxies... but model fixed.

Remaining ideas with potential:

A. Product/commodity-level features: household's spend share in its top commodities, and importantly the *growth* in specific departments. E002 dept shares didn't help. Probably weak.

```python
import agent_api, pandas as pd, numpy as np

base = agent_api.load_saved("e011_discounts.parquet")
base = base.set_index(["household_key", "snapshot_day"])  # careful: keep columns

def add_feats(view, sd):
    hh = pd.Index(view.households)
    tr = view.table("transactions")
    tr = tr[tr["household_key"].isin(set(hh))].copy()
    tr["dow"] = tr["day"] % 7
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    eps = 1e-9

    for win, tag in ((84, "84"), (364, "364")):
        w = tr[tr["day"] > sd - win]
        # trip-level table
        trips = w.groupby(["household_key", "basket_id"]).agg(day=("day", "first"), store=("store_id", "first"), ttime=("trans_time", "first"))
        g = trips.groupby("household_key")
        ntr = g.size()
        nst = trips.groupby("household_key")["store"].nunique()
        # primary store share
        st_cnt = trips.groupby(["household_key", "store"]).size()
        st_max = st_cnt.groupby("household_key").max()
        out[f"n_stores_{tag}"] = nst
        out[f"prim_store_share_{tag}"] = st_max / (ntr + eps)
        # store entropy
        p = st_cnt / st_cnt.groupby("household_key").transform("sum")
        ent = -(p * np.log(p + eps)).groupby("household_key").sum()
        out[f"store_ent_{tag}"] = ent
        # dow features (84 only)
        if win == 84:
            d_cnt = trips.groupby(["household_key", "dow"]).size()
            d_tot = d_cnt.groupby("household_key").transform("sum")
            p = d_cnt / d_tot
            out["dow_ent_84"] = -(p * np.log(p + eps)).groupby("household_key").sum()
            out["dow_top_share_84"] = d_cnt.groupby("household_key").max() / (ntr + eps)
            out["dow_n_84"] = trips.groupby("household_key")["dow"].nunique()
            out["dow_late_share_84"] = trips.assign(late=trips["dow"] >= 5).groupby("household_key")["late"].mean()
            out["ttime_mean_84"] = g["ttime"].mean()
            out["ttime_morning_share_84"] = trips.assign(m=trips["ttime"] < 1200).groupby("household_key")["m"].mean()
    # product breadth 84
    w84 = tr[tr["day"] > sd - 84]
    g84 = w84.groupby("household_key")
    out["n_products_84"] = g84["product_id"].nunique()
    out["n_depts_84"] = g84["department"].nunique() if "department" in w84 else np.nan
```

import agent_api, pandas as pd, numpy as np

base = agent_api.load_saved("e011_discounts.parquet")
base = base.set_index(["household_key", "snapshot_day"])  # careful: keep columns

def add_feats(view, sd):
    hh = pd.Index(view.households)
    tr = view.table("transactions")
    tr = tr[tr["household_key"].isin(set(hh))].copy()
    tr["dow"] = tr["day"] % 7
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    eps = 1e-9

    for win, tag in ((84, "84"), (364, "364")):
        w = tr[tr["day"] > sd - win]
        # trip-level table
        trips = w.groupby(["household_key", "basket_id"]).agg(day=("day", "first"), store=("store_id", "first"), ttime=("trans_time", "first"))
        g = trips.groupby("household_key")
        ntr = g.size()
        nst = trips.groupby("household_key")["store"].nunique()
        # primary store share
        st_cnt = trips.groupby(["household_key", "store"]).size()
        st_max = st_cnt.groupby("household_key").max()
        out[f"n_stores_{tag}"] = nst
        out[f"prim_store_share_{tag}"] = st_max / (ntr + eps)
        # store entropy
        p = st_cnt / st_cnt.groupby("household_key").transform("sum")
        ent = -(p * np.log(p + eps)).groupby("household_key").sum()
        out[f"store_ent_{tag}"] = ent
        # dow features (84 only)
        if win == 84:
            d_cnt = trips.groupby(["household_key", "dow"]).size()
            d_tot = d_cnt.groupby("household_key").transform("sum")
            p = d_cnt / d_tot
            out["dow_ent_84"] = -(p * np.log(p + eps)).groupby("household_key").sum()
            out["dow_top_share_84"] = d_cnt.groupby("household_key").max() / (ntr + eps)
            out["dow_n_84"] = trips.groupby("household_key")["dow"].nunique()
            out["dow_late_share_84"] = trips.assign(late=trips["dow"] >= 5).groupby("household_key")["late"].mean()
            out["ttime_mean_84"] = g["ttime"].mean()
            out["ttime_morning_share_84"] = trips.assign(m=trips["ttime"] < 1200).groupby("household_key")["m"].mean()
    # product breadth 84
    w84 = tr[tr["day"] > sd - 84]
    g84 = w84.groupby("household_key")
    out["n_products_84"] = g84["product_id"].nunique()
    out["n_depts_84"] = g84["department"].nunique() if "department" in w84 else np.nan

              "ew_7","ew_14","ew_28","ew_56","ew_84","ew_180","spend_364",
              "avg_basket_84","lr_mean28","lr_med28","rd_84","rd_364","cd_84","cd_364",
              "net_spend_364","basket_max_84","longrun_wk"]
count_like = ["baskets_28","baskets_84","trips_per_wk_84","trips_364","active_days_28",
              "active_days_364","n_products_84","n_stores_84","coup_trips_84","coup_trips_364",
              "redem_84","days_since_last","days_since_first","days_since_redem","active_28"]

new = pd.DataFrame(index=E.index)
for c in spend_like:
    x = pd.to_numeric(E[c], errors="coerce")
    new[c+"_sqrt"] = np.sqrt(x.clip(lower=0))
    new[c+"_log"] = np.log1p(x.clip(lower=0))
for c in count_like:
    if c in E.columns:
        x = pd.to_numeric(E[c], errors="coerce")
        new[c+"_sqrt"] = np.sqrt(x.clip(lower=0))

T = pd.concat([E, new], axis=1)
print("shape:", T.shape)

# holdout check at 431
tt = agent_api.train_targets()
tmap = tt.set_index(["snapshot_day","household_key"]).future_spend_4w
def num(df, cols):
    return df[cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(float).values
feat_cols = [c for c in T.columns if c not in ("household_key","snapshot_day")]
tr = T[T.snapshot_day < 431]; te = T[T.snapshot_day == 431]
Xtr = num(tr, feat_cols); ytr = tmap.loc[list(zip(tr.snapshot_day.astype(int), tr.household_key))].values
Xte = num(te, feat_cols); yte = tmap.loc[(431, te.household_key)].values
for name, cols in [("E011", [c for c in base_cols]), ("E011+tf", feat_cols)]:
    Xtr2 = num(tr, cols); Xte2 = num(te, cols)
    b, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(np.column_stack([np.ones(len(Xtr2)), Xtr2]), ytr, rcond=None)
    pred = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(Xte2)), Xte2])@b
    print(name, "holdout-431 MAE:", round(np.abs(yte-pred).mean(),2))

path = agent_api.save_table(T, "e014_transforms.parquet")
print("saved:", path)

    return np.abs(ptr-ytr).mean(), np.abs(pva-yva).mean()

import numpy as np, pandas as pd

BASE = load_saved('e011_discounts.parquet')

def fn(view, sd):
    b = BASE[BASE['snapshot_day'] == sd].drop(columns=['snapshot_day']).set_index('household_key')
    hh = pd.Index(b.index)
    t = view.table('transactions')
    t = t[t.household_key.isin(hh)]

    # ---- campaigns ----
    camps = view.campaigns  # started only
    ct = view.campaign_targets
    ct = ct[ct.household_key.isin(hh)]
    cmap_type = camps.set_index('campaign')['description']
    cmap_start = camps.set_index('campaign')['start_day']
    cmap_end = camps.set_index('campaign')['end_day']
    ct2 = ct.copy()
    ct2['ctype'] = ct2.campaign.map(cmap_type)
    ct2['cstart'] = ct2.campaign.map(cmap_start)
    ct2['cend'] = ct2.campaign.map(cmap_end)
    g = ct2.groupby('household_key')
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    f['n_targ_camps'] = g['campaign'].nunique()
    for typ in ['TypeA','TypeB','TypeC']:
        sub = ct2[ct2.ctype == typ]
        f['targ_n_' + typ] = sub.groupby('household_key')['campaign'].nunique()
        f['targ_ever_' + typ] = f['targ_n_' + typ] > 0
    act = ct2[(ct2.cstart <= sd) & (ct2.cend >= sd)]
    f['n_targ_active'] = act.groupby('household_key')['campaign'].nunique()
    rec = ct2[(sd - ct2.cstart) <= 56]
    f['n_targ_recent56'] = rec.groupby('household_key')['campaign'].nunique()
    rec84 = ct2[(sd - ct2.cstart) <= 84]
    f['n_targ_recent84'] = rec84.groupby('household_key')['campaign'].nunique()

    # ---- coupon redemptions ----
    cr = view.coupon_redemptions
    cr = cr[cr.household_key.isin(hh)]
    cr2 = cr.copy()
    cr2['ctype'] = cr2.campaign.map(cmap_type)
    g2 = cr2.groupby('household_key')
    f['n_redem_total'] = g2['day'].count()
    for w in [28, 56, 84, 180, 364]:
        f['n_redem_' + str(w)] = cr2[cr2.day > sd - w].groupby('household_key')['day'].count()
    f['days_since_redem2'] = sd - g2['day'].max()
    f['days_since_first_redem'] = sd - g2['day'].min()
    f['n_redem_camps'] = g2['campaign'].nunique()
    for typ in ['TypeA','TypeB','TypeC']:
        f['n_redem_' + typ] = cr2[cr2.ctype == typ].groupby('household_key')['day'].count()
    # engaged: redeemed under campaigns they were targeted by
    pairs_cr = set(map(tuple, cr2[['household_key','campaign']].drop_duplicates().values))
    pairs_ct = set(map(tuple, ct2[['household_key','campaign']].drop_duplicates().values))
    eng = pairs_cr & pairs_ct
    eng_s = pd.Series([1]*len(eng), index=pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples(eng)) if eng else pd.Series(dtype=float)
    ...

```python
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

BASE = load_saved('e011_discounts.parquet')

def fn(view, sd):
    b = BASE[BASE['snapshot_day'] == sd].drop(columns=['snapshot_day']).set_index('household_key')
    hh = pd.Index(b.index)
    t = view.table('transactions')
    t = t[t.household_key.isin(hh)]

    # ---- campaigns ----
    camps = view.campaigns  # started only
    ct = view.campaign_targets
    ct = ct[ct.household_key.isin(hh)]
    cmap_type = camps.set_index('campaign')['description']
    cmap_start = camps.set_index('campaign')['start_day']
    cmap_end = camps.set_index('campaign')['end_day']
    ct2 = ct.copy()
    ct2['ctype'] = ct2.campaign.map(cmap_type)
    ct2['cstart'] = ct2.campaign.map(cmap_start)
    ct2['cend'] = ct2.campaign.map(cmap_end)
    g = ct2.groupby('household_key')
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    f['n_targ_camps'] = g['campaign'].nunique()
    for typ in ['TypeA','TypeB','TypeC']:
        sub = ct2[ct2.ctype == typ]
        f['targ_n_' + typ] = sub.groupby('household_key')['campaign'].nunique()
        f['targ_ever_' + typ] = f['targ_n_' + typ] > 0
    act = ct2[(ct2.cstart <= sd) & (ct2.cend >= sd)]
    f['n_targ_active'] = act.groupby('household_key')['campaign'].nunique()
    rec = ct2[(sd - ct2.cstart) <= 56]
    f['n_targ_recent56'] = rec.groupby('household_key')['campaign'].nunique()
    rec84 = ct2[(sd - ct2.cstart) <= 84]
    f['n_targ_recent84'] = rec84.groupby('household_key')['campaign'].nunique()

    # ---- coupon redemptions ----
    cr = view.coupon_redemptions
    cr = cr[cr.household_key.isin(hh)]
    cr2 = cr.copy()
    cr2['ctype'] = cr2.campaign.map(cmap_type)
    g2 = cr2.groupby('household_key')
    f['n_redem_total'] = g2['day'].count()
    for w in [28, 56, 84, 180, 364]:
        f['n_redem_' + str(w)] = cr2[cr2.day > sd - w].groupby('household_key')['day'].count()
    f['days_since_redem2'] = sd - g2['day'].max()
    f['days_since_first_redem'] = sd - g2['day'].min()
    f['n_redem_camps'] = g2['campaign'].nunique()
    for typ in ['TypeA','TypeB','TypeC']:
        f['n_redem_' + typ] = cr2[cr2.ctype == typ].groupby('household_key')['day'].count()
    # engaged: redeemed under campaigns they were targeted by
    pairs_cr = set(map(tuple, cr2[['household_key','campaign']].drop_duplicates().values))
    pairs_ct = set(map(tuple, ct2[['household_key','campaign']].drop_duplicates().values))
    eng = pairs_cr & pairs_ct
    eng_s = pd.Series([1]*len(eng), index=pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples(eng)) if eng else pd.Series(dtype=float)
    ...
```

```python
def build_cm(view, s, K=13):
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    sp = tx.groupby(['household_key','day'])['sales_value'].sum().reset_index()
    # per household: day -> cummax last day
    rows = []
    for k in range(1, K+1):
        t0 = s - 28*k
        if t0 < 28: break
        w_end = t0 + 28
        yk = sp[(sp.day > t0) & (sp.day <= w_end)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
        x1k = sp[(sp.day > t0-28) & (sp.day <= t0)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
        lastk = sp[sp.day <= t0].groupby('household_key')['day'].max()
        df = pd.DataFrame({'gap': t0 - lastk, 'x1': x1k, 'y': yk})
        rows.append(df.reset_index())
    pool = pd.concat(rows)
    return pool
```

```python
def build_cm(view, s, K=13):
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    sp = tx.groupby(['household_key','day'])['sales_value'].sum().reset_index()
    # per household: day -> cummax last day
    rows = []
    for k in range(1, K+1):
        t0 = s - 28*k
        if t0 < 28: break
        w_end = t0 + 28
        yk = sp[(sp.day > t0) & (sp.day <= w_end)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
        x1k = sp[(sp.day > t0-28) & (sp.day <= t0)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
        lastk = sp[sp.day <= t0].groupby('household_key')['day'].max()
        df = pd.DataFrame({'gap': t0 - lastk, 'x1': x1k, 'y': yk})
        rows.append(df.reset_index())
    pool = pd.concat(rows)
    return pool
```

def ridge_fit_pred(Xtr, ytr, Xva, alpha):
    mu = Xtr.mean(0); sd = Xtr.std(0)+1e-9
    Z = (Xtr-mu)/sd; Zv = (Xva-mu)/sd
    A = Z.T@Z + alpha*np.eye(Z.shape[1])
    w = np.linalg.solve(A, Z.T@ytr)
    b = ytr.mean()
    return Zv@w + b
```

def ridge_fit_pred(Xtr, ytr, Xva, alpha):
    mu = Xtr.mean(0); sd = Xtr.std(0)+1e-9
    Z = (Xtr-mu)/sd; Zv = (Xva-mu)/sd
    A = Z.T@Z + alpha*np.eye(Z.shape[1])
    w = np.linalg.solve(A, Z.T@ytr)
    b = ytr.mean()
    return Zv@w + b
```
